context: A uni student counsels a teen friend going through friend drama
purpose: Teach: あたりまえ/所詮/異様/つぎ/目当て/頬/かかわり/いのち

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ねえ、聞いてよ。最近グループの雰囲気が異様に冷たくてさ、もう学校行きたくない。
lines.en: Hey, listen. The vibe in our group's been weirdly cold lately, I don't even want to go to school.
lines.style: Teen girl venting, voice cracking slightly, fast and emotional delivery.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 落ち着いて。頬、ちょっと赤くなってるよ。何があったか、ざっくりでいいから話してみ?
lines.en: Calm down. Your cheeks are a bit red. Just tell me roughly what happened.
lines.style: Gentle older-brother tone, warm and steady, slowing the pace deliberately.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ミナがあたしの彼氏目当てで近づいてたって噂で…ずっと普通に信じてた友達なのに。
lines.en: There's a rumor Mina was only getting close to me to go after my boyfriend... and she was a friend I'd always just trusted.
lines.style: Hurt teenage betrayal, voice trembling, words tumbling out quickly.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: うわ、それはきついな。でも所詮は噂だろ?本人に口頭で確認したのか?
lines.en: Ugh, that's rough. But it's just a rumor in the end, right? Did you actually ask her face to face?
lines.style: Reasonable uni-student tone, pushing back kindly without dismissing her pain.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: してない…怖くて。もし本当だったら、人とのかかわりが全部信じられなくなりそうで。
lines.en: No... I'm scared. If it's true, I feel like I won't be able to trust any human connection anymore.
lines.style: Quiet, withdrawn confession, almost whispered, holding back tears.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: わかるよ。でもさ、確かめないままだと不安だけが膨らんでいくぞ。つぎ会ったとき、ちゃんと聞いてみな。
lines.en: I get it. But if you don't check, the anxiety just keeps swelling. Next time you see her, ask her properly.
lines.style: Caring advice, leaning forward, balanced between empathy and gentle push.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ミナを疑うなんて、あたしには죽음級…じゃなくて、いのちがけくらい重い気がしてたの。
lines.en: Doubting Mina felt almost life-or-death heavy to me, you know.
lines.style: Vulnerable admission, voice small, half-laughing at her own dramatic framing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: いのちがけは大げさだって(笑)。友達なら、疑うのがあたりまえじゃなくて、聞くのがあたりまえなんだよ。
lines.en: Risking your life is way over the top (laughs). With a friend, asking is the natural thing, not doubting.
lines.style: Warm laugh, teasing but reassuring, landing the punchline softly.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: …うん。明日、ちゃんと向き合ってみる。ありがとう、レン兄。やっと頬がゆるんだ気がする。
lines.en: ...Yeah. Tomorrow, I'll face it properly. Thanks, Ren. I feel like my face finally relaxed.
lines.style: Soft resolve returning, small laugh through the tears, grateful and lighter.
